# Banana Detail

> Mobile car detailing. Interior and exterior details, paint correction and ceramic
> coating, carried out by hand at the customer's home or workplace.

Services and starting prices (CAD):
- Express Wash & Wax — $60
- Interior Detail — $150
- Exterior Detail — $140
- Full Detail, inside and out — $250
- Paint Correction — $400
- Ceramic Coating — $650
- Engine Bay Cleaning — $70
- Headlight Restoration — $80
- Pet Hair & Odour Removal — $60

Final prices depend on vehicle size and condition and are agreed before work begins.

Booking: the customer sends photos, receives a price and a time, then confirms through a
link that carries the booking details and the service terms. No deposit. Payment is due
on completion.

## Pages
- [Home](https://reflex08.github.io/banana-detail/): services, pricing, process and FAQ.

Note: llms.txt is a community proposal, not a search standard, and no engine is known to
require it. It costs nothing to publish and is kept consistent with the page itself.
